text:
jamie-frontend: Hey — new signup here, email verified + phone verified, added Apple Pay as payment method, but the trial credits never showed up in the dashboard. account id acct_ghT9. Can someone check?

sara-cs: thanks for flagging. quick Q: did they see any PM errors at signup (3DS/decline) or any webhook failures?

jamie-frontend: customer says Apple Pay flow completed, 3DS success message on their end. no declines. they just see balance $0.00 and onboarding banner still prompting to claim trial.

sara-cs: ok I'm pulling the account now. pinging fraud checks + billing.

fraudbot: Automated check -> PM_BIN_MISMATCH: pm_bin_country=US account_country=DE risk_flag=manual_review note="ApplePay token BIN indicates US issuer; account locale DE"

liam-billing: seeing the bot result. Apple Pay tokens often surface BIN country of the card issuer which can trigger our region gate. since email+phone verified but no ID upload, system left it in manual_review. we can do a manual grant if CS confirms no fraud indicators.

sara-cs: confirmed customer passed email and phone verification, no suspicious activity in recent events, made 1 test request to hosted API (low usage). requesting manual grant now.

# internal command (for audit):
```
redwoodctl grants create --account acct_ghT9 --amount 50 --reason "Manual trial grant: BIN-country mismatch on ApplePay token; verified email+phone" --admin liam-billing
```
liam-billing: grant created: grant_id=grant_20260317_87, applied 50 credits, audit=inv_8723, expected propagation ~2-5m. also flagged account to avoid auto-blocking on future ApplePay BIN differences.

sara-cs: told customer to refresh in 5 min. will follow up with screenshot when credits show. :white_check_mark:

jamie-frontend: Customer confirmed after ~3m — trial credits visible now, says thanks. closing thread. :wave:
